name: core.openwop.workflows.tutorial-connect-your-ai
description: ADR 0488 D2 — the NESTING PROOF. The 'Connect Your AI' tutorial expressed as phase-granular sub-chains: one child chain per driveable phase, plus a parent chain that composes them via core.subWorkflow + subChainRef (RFC 0133). 'Show me this phase' runs a child; 'Drive the whole tutorial' runs the parent. Deliberately ONE tutorial: the ADR requires proving nesting on a single tutorial before converting the library.
